Thunder @ Heat 6/10 5:00 - SGA and Giannis both questionable
Pistons @ Hawks 5/10 underway - Cade's young Pistons against Atlanta
Celtics @ Warriors 4/10 7:30 - Curry out, Boston on back-to-back

games.notes: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander questionable; Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Caruso and Cason Wallace all out for OKC. Giannis questionable for Miami. Only worth it if both stars play; otherwise a patchwork Thunder, tough to call.
Cade Cunningham available, Jalen Duren out; CJ McCollum out for Atlanta. Detroit's young core against a mid Hawks team, watchable but not a must.
Curry, Butler and Porzingis out for Golden State, Paul George resting for Boston. Celtics on a back-to-back but should still win, likely a dull one.
Haliburton out, Siakam questionable for Indiana; Anunoby out, Towns questionable for the champs. Knicks on a back-to-back but should handle a bad Pacers team.
P.J. Washington doubtful, Clayton questionable for Dallas on a back-to-back. Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out for Utah. Flagg is the only reason to tune in, likely a Mavs win.
Banchero out for Orlando; Ayton and Carrington questionable for Washington. Two middling, banged-up teams, skip unless you need Wizards youth.
Jokic is not on the report, Claxton and Powell out for Chicago. Good team against a bad one, likely blowout.
